column1: # FASTag 1.12 v2 protease models for -digest_models_version v2 (#3c-#3e). OPT-IN AND UNFITTED:
# every value below is a prior, not a fit. Fitted by tools/digest_models.py --fit at the DEV
# regeneration on the 1.12 release candidate (PLAN-organism-chemistry.md, Item #3); not validated
# Models: the v1 cleavage rules (empirical ends of Arg-C, Asp-N, Glu-C and Chymotrypsin, once
# fitted, are Dirichlet-smoothed toward these rules), plus the rule-only rows LysargiNase
# (N-end K/R) and Asp-N_ambic (N-end D/E, class Asp-N).
# detection: weights per instrument class (orbitrap_hcd, timstof, other); 1 = neutral (unfitted).
# specificity: the background share of the Trypsin class and the pooled one of every other
# model; 0.05 = the v1 share (unfitted; the fit profiles {0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4}).
# reference: no row until the fit (the in-silico tryptic K:R of the pooled UniProt reference
# Rules: ExPASy PeptideCutter and OpenMS ProteaseDB (Enzymes.xml); Glu-C after E only (bicarbonate).
# A model end is uniform over its cleaving residues; '*' = the background at that end.

# background: residue composition of the UniProt human reference proteome UP000005640 (UP000005640_9606.fasta.gz, reference_proteomes, 20652 proteins, downloaded 2026-10-09), I counted as L, 11456316 residues.
# Source: UniProt (The UniProt Consortium, Nucleic Acids Res. 2025), CC BY 4.0.
